description: This file defines a React functional component called TrackCard, which displays information about a music track, and provides controls like play/pause and toggle favorite. It interacts with external services and context to manage playback state and user favorites.

methods.name: TrackCard({ track, allTracks })
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a music track with playback and favorite toggle controls.

methods.name: onPlayClick
methods.description: Handles click on Play/Pause button, toggles playback state.

methods.name: onFav
methods.description: Async function to toggle the favorite status of the track.
